question.text: A PM's FI portfolio has Modified Duration = 6 and holds Rs. 80 cr. Rates rise 50 bps. Ignoring convexity, approximate P&L:

explanation.text: The Logic: ΔV ≈ -MD × Δy × V = -6 × 0.005 × 80 cr = -2.4 cr. The Trap: Rs. 4.8 cr uses 100 bps; Rs. 0.24 cr uses 5 bps; gain is wrong sign. Cross-Exam Context: Same formula as Q16, Q25 — reinforced.
